definitions.explanation: Showing courage and determination in the face of danger, difficulty, or adversity.

examples.japanese: {勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勇敢|ゆうかん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救|すく}った→救う：02063_sukuu⟧。
examples.english: His courageous actions saved many people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{悪|わる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かった→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
examples.english: She courageously stood up against evil.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧ - to fight bravely
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ - courageous action
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}な⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧ - brave soldier
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - courageously (adverbial)
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}さ - bravery (noun form)

ADJECTIVE FORMS:
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}な + noun: {勇敢|ゆうかん}な⟦{戦士|せんし}→戦士：12747_senshi⟧
- {勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: {勇敢|ゆうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to challenge bravely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧ - courage (noun)
- ⟦{果敢|かかん}→果敢：07934_kakan⟧ - bold, daring (emphasizes decisiveness)
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧ - bold (can also mean reckless)
